sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: The Qwen3.5 27B native vision-language Dense model incorporates a linear attention mechanism, delivering fast response times while balancing inference speed and performance. Its overall capabilities are comparable to those of the Qwen3.5-122B-A10B.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-27B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-27B is Alibaba Cloud's dense multimodal foundation model with 27B parameters, released February 2026. Unlike the MoE variants, it uses a dense architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Feed Forward Networks.
